problem: Native XLSB cache reads rejected the ACUID identity prefix; cache edits could loop forever when rId(count+1) was occupied. Native dynamic-formula indexes also point to a CellMeta record immediately before the first cell, causing unrelated scalar insertion to fail with CorruptFile.
changes: Retain Cache.alternate_content, validating exactly one native 0x0c00 16-byte UID inside a bounded alternate-content envelope before the cache definition. Constructors leave it empty. Reads, writes and edits preserve the original product-version framing and UID bytes.

Reuse existing cache part names and relationship IDs for updates/reorderings of the same cache-name set. Verify exclusive inbound ownership. Cache add/remove scans a bounded n+1 numeric ID range instead of repeatedly trying an occupied rId(count+1).

Bind native first-cell metadata prefixes after validating contiguous CellMeta/ValueMeta ordering and four-byte payloads. Expose the actual cell record for lookup. Require both actual-cell and prefix geometry to stay equal before preserving an index unchanged; rewrite prefix-only changes.
Add eleven owning-crate native tests and one operations test; expand the fixture/feature assertion index without promoting historical pending evidence.

Correct worksheet print capability claims: manual page breaks are typed, while worksheet setup, margins, print flags and header/footer remain opaque package records. Chart-sheet print metadata support is a separate existing family.

verification_scope.slicer_read: Two caches: exact names/hierarchies, internal cache ID2018148052, PivotTable1/sheet ID2 bindings, sort/cross-filter/custom-list flags and both selected-item pairs. Re-encoding both native cache parts is byte exact, including UID envelopes.
verification_scope.slicer_edits: Caption edit changes only slicer1.bin; sort metadata changes only slicerCache1.bin; reordering changes only workbook.bin. Reopen/readback and inverse compare complete member payloads. Add/remove covers sparse numeric IDs and keeps new cache identity separate from native UIDs.
verification_scope.slicer_negatives: In-memory native derivatives reject inconsistent product counts, short/duplicate UIDs, missing/nonempty AC ends, wrong record kinds and repeated prefixes; writer rejects doubled identity blocks and caller raw payload limits remain effective.
verification_scope.pivot_table: Native visual-analytics/pivot-controls retain exact view names/cache IDs/catalog positions and Table1 range/header/column captions. All eight PivotCache records are decoded, including direct DateTime and shared-item DateTime variants, and exact cached totals175.5/9.5 are checked.
verification_scope.notes: Native A2/A3 authors, complete text and three font runs agree on eager/source owners. Replacing A2 text retains the other note, VML and every unrelated member. The writer supplies its required default-font run for new plain text; inverse after reopen restores every original payload.
verification_scope.dates_layout_breaks: Native1904 flag, six exact stored serials, hidden rows14/15, hidden J and A:B widths; row break19/column break6. Add/readback/inverse preserves all records outside the row-break block and all other members.
verification_scope.formula_groups: Exact C4:C7, D5:D68, D69:D103, A4:B6 and D4:E5 group ranges and group payload round trips. All100 copied/shared expressions/caches, CSE expression/range/caches,11 dynamic/LET caches and20 what-if outputs are checked. Dynamic expressions retain explicit Opaque(Unsupported) status, original tokens/ancillary bytes and group binding rather than pretending to be rendered/evaluated formulas.
verification_scope.scenarios: BASELINE_009 and ALTERNATE_009 retain comments, input-cell/value pairs, locked/hidden/current/shown state. Comment editing preserves all non-scenario worksheet records and other package parts, leaves inputs/model result10/2/25 intact and inverses exactly.
verification_scope.binary_index: Native sheet2 index offset358 points to a six-byte CellMeta prefix before A4 at364. Bound lookup returns actual cell boundaries and exact caches. Preceding/interior/later-cell/foreign-record offsets fail. A unit test covers two metadata records, duplicate refusal and index rewriting when only prefix identity changes.
verification_scope.operations: Auto/Eager routes query native D103=206 and its rendered formula, create number/text cells across two sheets, update/delete a stored record, keep dynamic/LET caches and inverse to exact original bytes. Virtual absent cells display (empty); owning readback confirms the record is absent.
verification_scope.validation_timing: Full owning/operations/facade suites passed. The index unit was repeated after replacing its test-only numeric cast with a checked conversion; the native owner target was repeated on the committed source. Clippy warnings are pre-existing vendored zlib-rs warnings, not errors in changed crates.
verification_scope.provenance: All139 fixtures and4 assets pass size/SHA integrity. Native bytes were not changed. No fresh Microsoft Office reopen, rendering, evaluation, refresh, macro/control execution or external fetch occurred.
